arxiv-2005-12815.title: Local Motion Planner for Autonomous Navigation in Vineyards with a RGB-D Camera-Based Algorithm and Deep Learning Synergy
arxiv-2005-12815.creator: Diego Aghi, Vittorio Mazzia, and Marcello Chiaberge
arxiv-2005-12815.description: Abstract With the advent of agriculture 3.0 and 4.0, in view of efficient and sustainable use of resources, researchers are increasingly focusing on the development of innovative smart farming and precision agriculture technologies by introducing automation and robotics into the agricultural processes.

arxiv-2101-01872.title: MULTI-STAGE RESIDUAL HIDING FOR IMAGE-INTO-AUDIO STEGANOGRAPHY
arxiv-2101-01872.creator: Wenxue Cui, Shaohui Liu, Feng Jiang, Yongliang Liu, Debin Zhao
arxiv-2101-01872.description: Abstract The widespread application of audio communication technologies has speeded up audio data flowing across the Internet, which made it a popular carrier for covert communication. In this paper, we present a cross-modal steganography method for hiding image content into audio carriers while preserving the perceptual fidelity of the cover audio.

arxiv-2401-03509.title: The fluctuation-dissipation relation holds for a macroscopic tracer in an active bath
arxiv-2401-03509.creator: Dima Boriskovsky, Benjamin Lindner, Yael Roichman
arxiv-2401-03509.description: Abstract The fluctuation-dissipation relation (FDR) links thermal fluctuations and dissipation at thermal equilibrium through temperature. Extending it beyond equilibrium conditions in pursuit of broadening thermodynamics is often feasible, albeit with system-dependent specific conditions. We demonstrate experimentally that a generalized FDR holds for a harmonically trapped tracer colliding with self-propelled walkers.

arxiv-2407-13061.title: Use of Boosting Algorithms in Household-Level Poverty Measurement: A Machine Learning Approach to Predict and Classify Household Wealth Quintiles in the Philippines
arxiv-2407-13061.creator: Erika Lynet V. Salvador
arxiv-2407-13061.description: Abstract This study assessed the effectiveness of machine learning models in predicting poverty levels in the Philippines using five boosting algorithms: Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost), Cat Boosting (CatBoost), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost).

arxiv-2501-07508.title: Improving DeFi Accessibility through Efficient Liquidity Provisioning with Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2501-07508.creator: Haonan Xu, Alessio Brini
arxiv-2501-07508.description: Abstract This paper applies deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to optimize liquidity provisioning in Uniswap v3, a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol implementing an automated market maker (AMM) model with concentrated liquidity. We model the liquidity provision task as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and train an active liquidity provider (LP) agent using the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm.

arxiv-2510-00514.title: EuroSpeech: A Multilingual Speech Corpus
arxiv-2510-00514.creator: Samuel Pfisterer, Florian Grötschla, Luca A. Lanzendörfer, Roger Wattenhofer
arxiv-2510-00514.description: Abstract Recent progress in speech processing has highlighted that high-quality performance across languages requires substantial training data for each individual language. While existing multilingual datasets cover many languages, they often contain insufficient data for most languages. Thus, trained models perform poorly on the majority of the supported languages.

arxiv-2510-07472.title: Characterization of the Trans-Alfvénic Region Using Observations from Parker Solar Probe

Goldstein
arxiv-2510-07472.description: Abstract Close to Earth the solar wind is usually super-Alfvénic, i.e. the speed of the solar wind is much larger than the Alfvén speed. However, in the lower coronal regions, the solar wind is mostly sub-Alfvénic. With the Parker Solar Probe (PSP) crossing the boundary between the sub- and super-Alfvénic flow, Bandyopadhyay et al.

arxiv-2510-17932.title: From Charts to Code: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Multimodal Models
arxiv-2510-17932.creator: Jiahao Tang, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Lijian Wu, Yifei Tao, Dongxing Mao, Yang Wan Jingru Tan Min Zeng Min Li Alex Jinpeng Wang
arxiv-2510-17932.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiahao Tang, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Lijian Wu, Yifei Tao, Dongxing Mao, Yang Wan Jingru Tan Min Zeng Min Li Alex Jinpeng Wang. We introduce Chart2Code, a new benchmark for evaluating the chart understanding and code generation capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). Chart2Code is explicitly designed from a user-driven perspective, capturing diverse real-world scenarios and progressively increasing task difficulty.

arxiv-2511-05963.title: Next-Latent Prediction Transformers Learn Compact World Models
arxiv-2511-05963.creator: Jayden Teoh, Manan Tomar, Kwangjun Ahn, Edward S. Hu, Pratyusha Sharma, Riashat Islam, Alex Lamb, John Langford
arxiv-2511-05963.description: Abstract Transformers replace recurrence with a memory that grows with sequence length and self-attention that enables ad-hoc look ups over past tokens. Consequently, they lack an inherent incentive to compress history into compact latent states with consistent transition rules. This often leads to learning solutions that generalize poorly.

arxiv-2601-20063.title: Search for heavy long-lived charged particles with level-1 trigger scouting data from proton-proton collisions at s = 13.6 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13.6\TeV
arxiv-2601-20063.description: Abstract A search for heavy long-lived charged particles at the LHC is presented. Particles interacting with the CMS muon detector across several bunch crossings are searched for using a data sample of proton-proton collisions at s = 13.6 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13.6\TeV collected with the CMS detector in 2024, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 3.7 \fbinv .

doe-osti-3375565-cybersecurity-workforce.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. No existing cybersecurity training program addresses this intersection of nuclea

pmc-10525688.title: Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles (ZnO-NPs) Induce Cytotoxicity in the Zebrafish Olfactory Organs via Activating Oxidative Stress and Apoptosis at the Ultrastructure and Genetic Levels
pmc-10525688.creator: Sheren A. Al-Zahaby, Mayada R. Farag, Mahmoud Alagawany, Heba S. A. Taha, Maria Vittoria Varoni, Giuseppe Crescenzo, Suzan Attia Mawed
pmc-10525688.description: Simple SummaryZinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO-NPs) can exert toxic effects on living organisms. The fish olfactory epithelium is considered the first organ affected by ZnO-NPs, and we demonstrated that a 60-day exposure to ZnO-NPs induced significant malformations of the olfactory rosettes at histological, ultrastructural, and genetic levels in zebrafish, affecting the cellular repairing mechanisms.

pmc-10600334.title: Machine learning‐based prediction of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women with clinical examined features: A quantitative clinical study
pmc-10600334.creator: Kainat A. Ullah, Faisal Rehman, Muhammad Anwar, Muhammad Faheem, Naveed Riaz
pmc-10600334.description: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disease that is commonly seen in older people but often neglected due to its silent nature. To overcome the issue of osteoporosis in men and women, we proposed an advanced prediction model with the help of machine learning techniques which can help to identify the potential occurrence of this bone disease by its advanced screening tools.

pmc-11610345.title: Triglyceride glucose index: a significant prognostic marker of heart failure in patients with chronic kidney disease
pmc-11610345.creator: Shijie Liu, Xuefu Chen, Qian Guo, Jingwen Dou, Jiaxin Huang, Lewen Jia
pmc-11610345.description: BackgroundTriglycerides and glucose (TyG) index, a relatively convenient method for assessing insulin resistance, has been confirmed as an independent predictor both for chronic kidney disease (CKD) and cardiovascular disease (CVD) in previous studies. However, a few studies focus on the prognostic value of TyG index for CVD in patients diagnosed with CKD, especially in advanced CKD patients.

pmc-12381992.title: Vonoprazan vs. high-dose esomeprazole in bismuth-containing quadruple therapy for Helicobacter pylori rescue treatment: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12381992.creator: Xuetian Qian, Bo Gao, Zhenqiu Chen, Zhenyu Zhang, Zongdan Jiang
pmc-12381992.description: BackgroundThe real-world comparative effectiveness study aimed to compare the effectiveness of vonoprazan (VON)-based therapy with high-dose esomeprazole (ESO)-based therapy in the re-eradication of Helicobacter pylori.MethodsThis real-world retrospective study analyzed patients at Nanjing First Hospital undergoing H. pylori re-eradication, who received either vonoprazan-based (VON) or high-dose esomeprazole-based (ESO) quadruple therapy.

pmc-12593184.title: Microbe‐responsive human γδ T cells: the peculiar case of Staphylococcus aureus
pmc-12593184.creator: Matthias Eberl, Manuel Mata Forsberg, James E McLaren, Eva Sverremark‐Ekström
pmc-12593184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Vγ9/Vδ2 T cells represent the largest γδ T‐cell population in human blood and possess a unique responsiveness towards microbial organisms by sensing the metabolite (E)‐4‐hydroxy‐3‐methyl‐but‐2‐enyl pyrophosphate (HMB‐PP) in the context of the butyrophilin family members BTN2A1 and BTN3A1. Curiously, the bacterium Staphylococcus aureus does not produce HMB‐PP but appears to be capable of inducing activation, cytokine expression and proliferation of Vγ9/Vδ2 T cells regardless, through a largely unknown mechanism.

pmc-12605797.title: Integrated care for people with multimorbidity into elective surgical pathways: mixed-methods co-design study
pmc-12605797.creator: Sivesh K Kamarajah, Jugdeep Dhesi, Kamlesh Khunti, Krishnarajah Nirantharakumar, Paul Cockwell, Clare Hughes, Paul Stern, Joyce Yeung, Dion G Morton, Aneel A Bhangu, Shalini Ahuja
pmc-12605797.description: BackgroundPeople with multiple long-term conditions (MLTC) commonly undergo elective surgery, yet current pathways remain poorly equipped to meet their complex needs. These pathways present a unique, time-sensitive opportunity to act. The aim of this study was to co-design a feasible intervention that integrates MLTC care into surgical pathways.

pmc-12634331.title: Epitranscriptomic control of cancer immunity and therapy resistance
pmc-12634331.creator: Xingsen Zhao, Suhua Guan
pmc-12634331.description: Epitranscriptomics, the study of dynamic chemical modifications on RNA mediated by “writers,” “erasers,” and “readers,” has emerged as a pivotal discipline in elucidating the intricate interplay between cancer and immune regulation. These reversible modifications (e.g. m6A, m5C, Ψ) govern RNA metabolism, stability, and translation, thereby exerting spatiotemporal control over immune cell differentiation, activation, and function.

pmc-13292437.title: Case report: Successful rescue of an adult patient with diquat poisoning complicated by rhabdomyolysis and compartment syndrome
pmc-13292437.creator: Yonghui Zhang, Xisheng Zheng, Zhang Tai’an, Feng Yongli, Zhang Chaoyuan, Sun Xiuqin, Jia Mingya, Li Changli, Xiao Jing, Ma Jing, Zhou Xiaochao, Wei Chao, Bai Bin
pmc-13292437.description: ObjectiveTo summarize the clinical experience of successfully treating a patient with diquat poisoning complicated by rhabdomyolysis and compartment syndrome at Nanyang Central Hospital, and to provide references for the diagnosis, treatment, and early identification of complications of such severe poisoning.MethodsThe clinical data of 1 patient with diquat poisoning combined with multiple complications were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-13493058.title: Tumor cell-specific exon 3-deleted FOXP3 isoform promotes growth and metastasis via STAT3 in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13493058.creator: Jia Peng, Yi Liu, Zhongqin Gong, Ming-Yue Li, Hao Jia, Xueqing Zhou, Calvin S H Ng, George G Chen, Shucai Yang
pmc-13493058.description: Forkhead box P3 (FOXP3), the master regulator of regulatory T cells (Tregs), is aberrantly expressed in tumor cells, including lung cancer. Alternative splicing generates multiple isoforms, among which the full-length FOXP3 (FOXP3FL) and exon 3-deleted variant (FOXP3Δ3) are predominant. We identified FOXP3Δ3 as the major isoform in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) tumor cells.

pmc-13556483.title: 110. Glutamatergic changes in the medial prefrontal cortex associated with psychosis history in bipolar disorder and their relationship to executive function
pmc-13556483.creator: C-Y Chang, C Y Wu, S-Y Wei, H H Chang, T-H Lu, W H Chang, C-F Hsu, R-Y Lin, F-Z Shaw, Y K Yang, P S Chen, H-H Tseng
pmc-13556483.description: BackgroundPsychosis affects over half of individuals with bipolar disorder (BD) and has been linked to glutamatergic dysfunction within the default mode network (DMN). Altered glutamate/GABA signaling in the DMN may contribute to cognitive deficits, yet findings remain inconsistent. Differences between BD with (BD-P) and without past psychotic experiences (BD-NP) remain underexplored, underscoring the need for further investigation.
